a.lede: The smart health company is gating third-party app syncing to its own subscription plan for new users.
a.title: Withings wants new users to pay $100 a year to sync with Apple Health

b.lede: Flo Health users will able to sync their cycle data with the Google Health app starting early next year.
b.title: Google teams up with menstrual health tracker Flo to develop new wellness hardware and sync apps
